# LeadHealth

> The live exchange marketplace for buying and selling verified healthcare leads and calls — built for insurance agents and agencies.

Website: https://www.leadhealth.co

## What Is LeadHealth?

LeadHealth is the stock market for healthcare leads and calls. Just like a financial exchange matches buyers and sellers of securities in real time, LeadHealth connects insurance agents who generate consumer leads with agents and agencies who need them — at transparent, market-driven prices.

Every lead on the platform is a real consumer who has expressed interest in health insurance coverage (ACA/Obamacare, Medicare Advantage, or Final Expense/life insurance) and provided explicit TCPA consent.

## How It Works

**For sellers (lead generators):**
- Generate leads via the TCPA-compliant intake form at /home
- Each lead is automatically scored 0–100 by the LeadHealth scoring engine
- List scored leads on the marketplace at your chosen price
- Credits are deposited to your account on each sale

**For buyers (agents and agencies):**
- Browse the live marketplace at /marketplace — filter by state, insurance type, score tier, and price
- Purchase leads instantly using platform credits
- Track purchased leads through the CRM pipeline (New → Contacted → Qualified → Converted)
- Set price alerts to be notified when a listing drops to your target price

**The Exchange:**
- Real-time pricing driven by supply, demand, and lead quality score
- AI demand forecasting shows which states and insurance types are trending
- Market trend data and heat maps guide buying and selling strategy
- Ticker-style live feed of marketplace activity

## Lead Scoring

Each lead is assigned a quality score (0–100) across seven dimensions:

| Factor | Max Points | Description |
|---|---|---|
| TCPA Consent | 25 | Binary — consented or not |
| Interest Type | 20 | Medicare=13, Final Expense=10, ACA=8; multi-interest bonus |
| Age Bracket | 15 | Age-to-product fit (Medicare: 65+, ACA: 26–54) |
| Recency | 15 | <6hr=15, <24hr=13, <7d=8, <30d=5, <90d=2 |
| State Demand | 10 | High-demand states (FL, CA, NY, TX, AZ) score higher |
| Income Fit | 8 | ACA: 100–400% FPL; FE: $18k–90k; Medicare: low-income |
| Completeness | 7 | DOB, income, household size, source quality, Medicaid status |

**Score Tiers:**
- PRIME (≥80) — green — highest quality, fastest to contact
- GOOD (≥60) — amber — solid leads with good conversion potential
- FAIR (≥40) — orange — usable but lower urgency
- LOW (<40) — red — high-risk or incomplete data

## Credit Economy

LeadHealth runs on an in-platform credit system — similar to tokens on a trading platform:
- Buyers purchase credit packages to fund marketplace transactions
- Sellers receive credits when their listings sell
- Full transaction ledger and credit history available in the dashboard
- Credits can be earned through the referral program

## Referral Program

Agents earn bonus credits for referring new users to the platform via a unique referral code. Referral activity is tracked and rewarded automatically.

## Platform Intelligence

- **Demand Forecasting** — AI-generated predictions of lead demand by state and insurance type
- **Market Trends** — State-level supply/demand and pricing data
- **Lead Aging** — Quality scores decay automatically over time (cron job every 15 minutes) reflecting real-world urgency
- **Price Alerts** — Watchlist triggers notify buyers when a listing hits their target price
- **Watchlist** — Save listings to monitor before purchasing

## Insurance Products Covered

- **ACA / Obamacare** — Affordable Care Act marketplace plans; premium subsidy and tax credit qualification
- **Medicare Advantage** — Medicare Part C supplemental plan leads; 65+ age group
- **Final Expense** — Whole life/burial insurance leads; income-qualified consumers

## Target Users

- Independent health insurance agents
- Insurance agency managers and team leads
- Lead aggregators and wholesalers
- Regional insurance carriers and FMOs (Field Marketing Organizations)

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: React 18, Vite, TanStack Query v5, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Recharts, Wouter
- Backend: Express.js + TypeScript, Drizzle ORM 0.45, PostgreSQL
- Auth: express-session + bcryptjs, session regeneration on login (CSRF/fixation hardened)
- Scheduling: node-cron — lead quality decay every 15 minutes
- UI: Dark terminal theme — JetBrains Mono, bg #070d1a

## Compliance

All consumer leads collected on LeadHealth include:
- Explicit TCPA consent checkbox with timestamp
- IP address logging at submission
- Clear disclosure language on all intake forms
- No government affiliation — this is a private insurance solicitation platform
